messages.content: They confirmed 10:00 a.m. for Monday. Price the Sunday overnight properly now, including getting from the airport to the hotel, then to the restaurant, and back to PIT. Also tell me whether renting a car is actually cheaper.

The Sunday structure gives you comfortable margins. The nonstop leaves O'Hare Sunday, September 14 at 6:35 p.m. and arrives in Pittsburgh at 9:05 p.m. The Monday return leaves PIT at 6:20 p.m. and reaches O'Hare at 7:05 p.m. The airport hotel has a complimentary shuttle until midnight, so Sunday transportation is covered. A ride from the hotel to the restaurant Monday morning is currently estimated at $42-$48 and takes 35-45 minutes.
And restaurant to airport? I need to know when I would have to walk out of the visit.

Allow 45-55 minutes to PIT in late-afternoon traffic. For the 6:20 p.m. departure, leave the restaurant by 3:40 p.m.; that targets airport arrival around 4:30 p.m. and leaves about 1 hour 50 minutes before departure. A ride is estimated at $50-$58. If the visit ends at 3:30, you have a ten-minute buffer to request the car and leave.
That works. Put the rides next to a rental, all in.

Rides: free hotel shuttle Sunday, $48 budgeted hotel-to-restaurant, and $58 restaurant-to-airport, for $106. Rental: $91 base and taxes, about $9 fuel, $18 overnight hotel parking, and no restaurant parking charge, for $118. The rental also requires collecting the car Sunday night and returning it Monday. Rides are $12 less and involve less handling.
What hotel did you verify, and what is the full trip total rather than another estimate?

The verified room is at the Hyatt Place Pittsburgh Airport, one king room for Sunday night. It is $149.00 including taxes, cancellable until 6:00 p.m. local time on September 13, with the airport shuttle included. The round-trip business fare is $525.00. O'Hare economy parking for Sunday through Monday is $72.00. Using the conservative $106 rideshare allowance, the complete trip total is $852.00. Of that, $746.00 is fixed flight, hotel, and O'Hare parking; only the two Monday rides can vary.
So the overnight version is exactly where the earlier estimate landed. How much usable time do I have Sunday and Monday?

Sunday remains a normal travel evening: arrive at 9:05 p.m., allow about 25 minutes to reach the shuttle pickup, and expect to be at the hotel around 10:00 p.m. Monday, leave the hotel at 8:50 a.m. for arrival at the restaurant around 9:35 a.m. That gives 25 minutes before the 10:00 start. The visit can run until 3:30 p.m., giving you five and a half hours on site before the required 3:40 departure.
That is enough. Before you book, confirm both flights are nonstop and that the hotel shuttle really runs at that arrival time.

Confirmed. Both flights are nonstop. The Sunday shuttle operates on request until midnight; after collecting your bag, you call the hotel from the marked hotel-shuttle pickup area. Your 9:05 p.m. arrival is within its operating window. The hotel also confirmed the king room and the $149.00 tax-inclusive total.
Book the flights and the room. Use rides Monday, not the rental.

The nonstop flights and one-night hotel are booked. Your flight confirmation is P6T9LR: Sunday, September 14, O'Hare to Pittsburgh, 6:35-9:05 p.m.; Monday, September 15, Pittsburgh to O'Hare, 6:20-7:05 p.m. The business fare charged is $525.00. The Hyatt Place Pittsburgh Airport confirmation is HPA-742816 for September 14-15, one king room at $149.00 including taxes, cancellable through 6:00 p.m. local time September 13. Use the complimentary hotel shuttle Sunday, then rides Monday; no rental was reserved. The trip total remains $852.00 including $72.00 O'Hare parking and a $106 rideshare allowance. Leave the hotel at 8:50 a.m. and the restaurant no later than 3:40 p.m.
